narratives.author: claude
narratives.headline: Nine-game Wednesday, five thin threes-and-points cards, all marked past play-to; Knicks and Spurs tags decide a lot
narratives.briefing: It is a full nine-game Wednesday with every game still to tip, but this is a quiet card: all five props carry Pass-level conviction around 30, and every one is marked past its play-to price, so the edge we published may already be gone. Do not chase a worse number. The honest backdrop is a morning record of 15-23-0 (-9.17u), although the closing line has moved toward our morning picks 26 times against 10, which says the reads are better than the results. Game-line leans are 21-45 (-26.16u) since 2026-11-11 and stay leans only. Before tip we are waiting on Karl-Anthony Towns (knee) and Josh Hart (shoulder) for New York, Jalen Smith (illness) for Chicago, and the Thunder frontcourt, where injury reports are not final yet.

cards.p|4396907|tpm|Over: Garland gets the softest matchup on the board for point-guard threes, with MEM #1 softest of 30, and the model projects 2.8 on secure minutes against a line of 2.5. What makes this wrong is the 41% blowout risk and a thin margin, with 6 of his last 10 finishing within 1 of the number, plus the market pricing it at only 44%.
cards.p|5023693|tpm|Over: Proctor has averaged 1.9 threes over his last 10 and the model has 1.7 against a 1.5 line, with Evan Mobley out for Cleveland. This one lives on minutes: 12.9 in his misses vs 24.6 when he cleared it, and the market (39%) has out-predicted the model on threes this season.
cards.p|3992|tpm|Over: Harden is averaging 3.1 threes over his last 10 against a 2.5 line, and the projection of 2.9 agrees. The risks are a 37% blowout rate, 7 of his last 10 landing within 1 of the number, and the Knicks' status changes for Towns and Hart, which will re-price this on the next run.
cards.p|4711294|tpm|Over: Buzelis has cleared 2.5 in 7 of his last 10 and his usage jumps without Caleb Wilson, who is out again with Norman Powell. The warning is tonight's spot: just 1 of 8 over 2.5 against CHA, plus a minutes dip in his misses.
cards.p|4222252|pts|Under: Hartenstein has stayed under 8.5 in 7 of his last 10 and MIN is #8 toughest of 30 for centers, with the projection sitting right on 8.5. The way this loses is a long night: he goes over when he plays long, and with OKC's frontcourt thinned out he is projected for 27.6 minutes; Kalshi also likes it less at 44%.

narratives.leans_note: The five game-line leans, led by MIA @ PHI Over 236.5 with Embiid doubtful and Giannis questionable, are model disagreements with the market only; the game-line record is poor and none is a bet.

narratives.headline: Midday: Bridges under moves to 12.5, three new 19:31Z props join, Proctor slips past his play-to, and nine morning-era picks are off
narratives.briefing: Since the morning edition the board has turned over hard: Darius Garland, James Harden, Matas Buzelis, Isaiah Hartenstein, Josh Giddey, Day'Ron Sharpe, Devin Booker, Rudy Gobert and Ajay Mitchell are all off as no longer +EV at their current prices, while Bennett Stirtz, Kenrich Williams and Draymond Green were added on the latest run. The best-shaped play left is Mikal Bridges Under, which the market moved from 11.5 at −120 to 12.5 at −102, a full point in our direction with the sim at 68%. Tyrese Proctor has drifted from +142 to +130, which is past the +138 play-to, so the morning price is gone. Everything on the board grades Pass on conviction (32 at the top), and the report is 15-23-0 (-9.17u) on morning picks and 18-22-0 (-5.20u) on finals, so treat this as a thin night. Josh Hart was upgraded to probable; Jalen Brunson (questionable) and Karl-Anthony Towns (day-to-day) remain the swing items for both NY props before the final edition.

cards.p|3147657|pts|Under: The line moved from 11.5 to 12.5 since this was added, the model projects 10.4 and he has stayed under 12.5 in 8 of his last 10. The risk is opportunity: Anunoby is out, his usage rises from 16% to 19% without him, and he is only 4 of 12 under 12.5 against CLE. A Brunson or Towns absence would push more shots his way, and the model has trailed the market on points this season.
cards.p|5023693|tpm|Over: The case is volume in a short-handed NY game: he averages 1.9 threes over his last 10 and the model projects 1.7. The price has slid to +130, past the +138 play-to, so at this number it is no longer a play; it also lives on minutes, with 12.9 in his misses against 24.6 in his makes.
cards.p|5241364|tpm|Over: Averaging 2.1 threes over his last 10 and the sim goes over 64% of the time, with Anthony Edwards out for MIN. Against it, MIN is the toughest matchup in the league for shooting guards on threes, and 7 of his last 10 finished within 1 of this number.
cards.p|6589|pts|Under: With Curry out, the sim still has him under 5.5 in 62% of games and he stayed under in 8 of his last 10. What would make it wrong is shot volume (6.2 attempts in his misses against 2.9 in his hits) and his record against SAC, where he is just 1 of 6 under 5.5.
cards.p|3133626|tpm|Over: This is the thinnest card on the board: the only reason for it is a model projection of 1.7 threes against 1.5, and conviction sits at 31 (Pass). Everything else argues against it: MIN is the toughest of 30 defenses on shooting-guard threes, he is 1 of 12 over 1.5 against MIN, and only 4 of his last 10 went over.

narratives.leans_note: Game lines are 21-45 (-26.16u) since 2026-11-11, so SAC +6.5, CLE +1.5, BKN +1.5 and the CHI @ CHA Over 219.5 added at 19:31Z are leans only, and the CLE number has already moved from 3.5 to 1.5 against us.

narratives.author: claude
narratives.headline: Final: every live prop is past its play-to price tonight; Caruso returns for OKC; game-line leans stay at 21-45
narratives.briefing: It is a thin, Pass-grade night: 9 games, 8 still to tip, and no prop on the board rated above conviction 31. The honest read on the 6:15pm refresh is that none of the five live props is still at or better than its play-to price: Proctor sits at +128 against a +136 play-to, Kenrich Williams at +154 against +164, Draymond Green at -101 against +105, Booker at -123 against -115, and Bridges re-entered at +101, shorter than his +108 play-to. Today removed James Harden threes, Bennett Stirtz threes and Darius Garland threes for no longer being +EV at tonight's line, plus earlier removals of Buzelis, Sharpe, Melton, Hartenstein, Giddey, Gobert and Ajay Mitchell. The late news that matters is Alex Caruso coming off OKC's injury report, which should cut into backcourt minutes for Stirtz (already removed) and is worth knowing on Kenrich Williams. The record argues for restraint: the final report is 18-22-0 (-5.20u), the morning report 15-23-0 (-9.17u), though morning picks have moved toward the closing line 26 times against 10.

cards.p|5023693|tpm|Over: Proctor's case rests on volume: 1.9 threes a game over his last 10, a 1.7 projection and 22.1 projected minutes with OG Anunoby and Evan Mobley out. What makes it wrong is minutes, since he averaged 12.9 in his misses, and tonight's +128 is already past the +136 play-to, so this is not a price to add at.
cards.p|3147657|pts|Under: Bridges has averaged 9 points over his last 10 and stayed under 11.5 in 7 of them, and the model projects 10.4. The risk is real: with Anunoby out his usage goes from 16% to 19%, and he has only 3 of 12 unders against CLE; the posted +101 is shorter than the +108 play-to, so the number has moved against the pick.
cards.p|3133626|tpm|Over: The only argument for Kenrich Williams is the 1.7 projection against a 1.5 line; recent form (4 of his last 10), a tough MIN matchup and 1 of 12 overs against MIN all point the other way. Caruso's return could also trim his 26.7 projected minutes, and at +154 he is past the +164 play-to.
cards.p|6589|pts|Under: Draymond Green stayed under 5.5 in 8 of his last 10 and the sim averages 4.7, with Curry out and Zach LaVine ruled out for SAC in the feed. What breaks it is shot volume (6.2 shots in the misses vs 2.9 in the hits) and a 1 of 6 under record against SAC; at -101 he is past the +105 play-to.
cards.p|3136193|pts|Under: Booker stayed under 24.5 in 6 of his last 10, the model projects 23.5 and 45% of sims are blowouts where starters sit late. The market has out-predicted the model on points this season, he needs fewer shots than his misses (19.9), and -123 is past the -115 play-to.

narratives.leans_note: Game lines are 21-45 (-26.16u) since 2026-11-11, so SAC +7.5, CLE +4.5 and the CHI @ CHA Over 217.5 are leans only, and LAC @ MEM Over 227.5 is already past its play-to.
